name: firebase-ios-sdk
description: Firebase SDK for Apple App Development
one_liner: The toolkit Google gives app developers so an iPhone or iPad app can handle login, storage, push notifications, and crash tracking without building any of that from scratch.
buyer: An indie iOS developer or small app agency who needs backend features (login, database, notifications) but has no time or budget to build a server.
business_use_cases: A solo developer launches a habit-tracking app in weeks instead of months by using it for login and data storage instead of building a backend.
A small agency building client apps standardizes on it so every project ships with analytics and crash reporting at no extra line-item cost.
A startup prototyping an MVP delays hiring a backend engineer until the app proves demand.

money_ideas.idea: An iOS freelancer bundles 'Firebase integration' as a fixed-price add-on for every client project.

steal_this: This weekend, build a tiny iOS starter app pre-wired with Firebase auth, Firestore, and push notifications, then sell it as a starter kit to other indie iOS developers.
